source: User reply in this conversation to the preceding CS2 scope proposal.
literal:
Me encaja bastante bien. Para Ct realente lo único que hay que mirar es si su estrategia de defensa esta dando efecto y si no hay cambios para intentar parar las entradas de T y amoldarse a sus ataques, corregirlo. CT como tal no tiene mucha estrategia ya que es mas defensa. La IA debe saber interpretar patrones de los T y decir si la defensa esta siendo buena o no, y porque. 
El resto de información lo veo todo correcto. Por tanto, vamos con la siguiente fase. Que debemos hacer?
accepted_cs2_scope: Common factual input: frame, objective, players/distribution, resources, events and available causal history.
Per-datum source, reference, observation/availability, perspective, unknowns and conflicts.
Preserve E03 @5, other cases @9, and later native supplements separately.
Shared T/CT structure where source and perspective are accredited; no tactical inference added by the adapter.
ct_focus_attributed_to_user: Interpret T attack patterns, explain defensive effectiveness and adaptation; correct ineffective defence when changes are justified.
user_opinion_not_automatic_taxonomy: CT como tal no tiene mucha estrategia ya que es mas defensa.
operational_limits_attributed_to_agent: Round outcomes can inform retrospective description but do not alone prove a good/bad defensive decision.
Individual and team legal information remain separate from spectator information.
Prescriptive correction still requires a better supported viable alternative under the product contract.
Repeated T patterns and absence of CT adaptation require comparable prior observations; no universal number of rounds or new labels is approved.
authorization: CS2 scope is framed; its dependent implementation can proceed within that scope without asking again. This receipt only records framing.
pending_in_their_own_phases: Specific CT tactical cases and operational criteria on real causal material.
Semantic specialist, provider/model, comparative experiment and budget.
Independent tactical evaluation, prescriptive coaching and promotion.
